verdict.rationale: Slack's Web API, Events API, webhook triggers, and CLI (slack-cli) provide programmatic, non-interactive automation surfaces suitable for CI/headless use — e.g., HTTP RPC calls, event subscriptions, workflow webhook triggers, and app scaffolding/deployment via CLI. However there's no explicit documentation of running the CLI in CI pipelines, no headless/service-mode guidance, and no first-party CI/CD examples. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration guides, headless deployment/service-mode documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation of automation workflows.
